verification.review_instruction: Review each project critically in its assigned business domain as a Fortune-enterprise adoption evaluator. This is a model review role, not a claim of real credentials or enterprise approval. Use frozen rubric anchors and actual code over claims. No score targets; do not count planned work as evidence.
verification.checks: scripts/verify_workflows.py passes 312 tests across 12 suites and eleven CLI example replays. The ten originally selected workflows are assessed; the eleventh Data Repair experiment remains in integrated tests only.
verification.independent_review: Two independent read-only audits cover five projects each, followed by fresh diff, corpus and evaluator review. Reproduced policy currency, claim policy, account currency, pre-receipt shortage, invalid ETA/calendar and impossible export chronology gaps were repaired. A negated-profit bypass was independently found and repaired before final assessment.
verification.browser: All five changed workflow examples return HTTP 200 with no console errors. Wide account tables were visually checked at desktop and mobile widths. Ambiguous and negated profitability questions hold in the real browser without a model call.
verification.live_planner_trial: Twelve independently authored and reviewed synthetic cases were frozen before one live pass. Original model: 10/12 strict plans, 11/12 answer states, 1/6 false-ready holds, mean latency 4.519 seconds. Rules: 11/12 answer states, 0/6 false-ready; parser developed with visible questions. Source hashes match. Original failure retained; subsequent deterministic correction regression-tested, no improved live accuracy claimed.
verification.production: No business-owner or domain-owner acceptance, representative enterprise dataset, target identity/security/provider/load/recovery approval, or measured business benefit. Historical September trials use old contracts; current source supersedes those input schemas. No production approval is claimed.
